subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing & commit options
messages:
From: Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Compliance options & pricing for Atma Medical
Cc: security-team@atma-med.com

Hi Grace and Dylan,

Thanks for taking our call last week. Per our procurement team, attached is a short RFP for the compliance/security add-ons we need to support a pilot: audit log retention (HIPAA-safe logging), HSM-backed KMS for key separation, and regional data residency (US-East and EU-West). We also want details on your HIPAA support (BAA scope) and any additional evidence you can share (SOC 2 cert, pen-test summary).

Key asks for a firm quote by COB Oct 12 so we can include it in our vendor packet:
- Pricing for 30/365/730-day audit log retention tiers (per-month and per-GB)
- Per-tenant KMS/HSM add-on (monthly and one-time setup)
- Regional residency fees (flat or per-GB) and availability SLA
- Any bundled discount if we commit to a 12-month or 24-month term

We attached the RFP. Procurement will likely issue a PO if terms fit our budget. Our expected baseline usage for the pilot is ~120k tokens/day and 2 TB of logs per month.

Thanks — looking forward to a clear, line-item response.

Best,
Leena Rao
Director, IT Procurement
Atma Medical
Attachment: atma_rfp_compliance_requirements.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance options & pricing for Atma Medical
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Leena — thanks for the RFP and the clear deadline. Quick summary below and I attached a preliminary pricing sheet so you can see SKUs side-by-side. High-level proposals:

- Audit logs: three retention SKUs (30 / 365 / 730 days). Pricing model we recommend for healthcare pilots is a flat monthly per-tenant fee plus a per-GB overage; sample: $750 / $1,800 / $3,200 per month respectively, with the first 500 GB included and $0.03/GB thereafter.
- KMS/HSM: two options — hosted KMS (software-managed keys) at $600/month per tenant; HSM-backed key custody (FIPS 140-2 validated HSM) at $2,500/month + a $5,000 one-time setup for HSM provisioning and dedicated key partitions.
- Residency: region attach fee of $1,200/month per region for isolated residency (includes routing and storage separation).
- HIPAA support: BAA available; HIPAA Bundle adds audit acceleration, higher retention, and dedicated logging pipeline at $1,400/month.

Bundle recommendation: "Compliance Plus" = Audit logs (365d) + HSM + Residency (US-East) + HIPAA bundle. Rough list price ~ $7,000/month for pilot scale (with the expected usage you listed).

Discounts and commercial flexibility: we can offer pilot credits ($10k) and a promotional 15% discount for the first 90 days. For committed annual spend we can discuss a tiered discount (example 12-month = 10% off add-ons; 24-month = 15% off).

Attachments: redwood_compliance_pricing_v1.xlsx (line-item SKUs, sample calculator).

A few follow-ups for accuracy: can you confirm whether you need EU residency active for the pilot or just demonstration? Also — do you require bring-your-own-HSM (we support customer HSMs via partner integrations) or is Redwood managing the HSM? Finally, if procurement prefers Marketplace procurement, we can provide a marketplace SKU that includes an additional marketplace-specific discount.

If you’d like, we can lock a draft commercial offer and send a DocuSign-ready proposal once we know the target term.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_compliance_pricing_v1.xlsx

From: Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance options & pricing for Atma Medical
Cc: security-team@atma-med.com

Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. A few clarifications:
1) For residency, we will need EU-West active for a subset of traffic during the trial (demo only) and US-East as our primary.
2) HSM: we prefer Redwood-managed HSM for the pilot (do not have on-prem HSM hardware).
3) Can you provide a single SKU/breakdown that shows bundled pricing for the Compliance Plus suggestion and then a line-item version so procurement can do a cost comparison?
4) Does the BAA include retained access logs for >=365 days by default or is that an add-on?

Procurement is hoping to finalize vendor selection by Oct 25. Are you able to provide a firm offer (line-item + committed discount for 12 months) by COB Oct 12? Also, what marketplace discount would you apply if we route via AWS Marketplace?

Thanks,
Leena

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance options & pricing for Atma Medical

Leena — looping in a clearer commercial approach. Per internal margin constraints and our typical enterprise packaging, proposed structure:

Option A (12-mo commitment, pilot):
- Compliance Plus (bundle): Audit logs 365d + hosted HSM + US-East residency + HIPAA Bundle = $6,800/month list
- Pilot credit: $15,000 one-time (applied against first invoices)
- Onboarding fee waived with 12-mo commit (normally $7,500)
- Annual commit discount: 12-mo = 12% off bundle; 24-mo = 18% off bundle
- AWS Marketplace routing: additional 5% discount if purchased through Marketplace (must accept marketplace T&Cs)

Option B (no commit):
- Same SKUs at list price; onboarding fee applies; no pilot credit

Notes for Grace: we should avoid more than 18% off at list for the first year unless we get a 36-month commitment. Also confirm whether HSM setup fee remains billable when we waive onboarding.

Dylan
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Compliance options & pricing for Atma Medical
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Leena — thanks. Quick update after an internal margin check: we can go ahead with a structured commercial that I think matches procurement needs while protecting margin:

Final commercial (draft):
- Compliance Plus bundle (365d audit + Redwood-managed HSM + EU-West & US-East residency + HIPAA bundle): $6,150/month list
- 12-month commit discount: 12% -> effective $5,412/month
- Pilot credit: $15,000 (one-time), applied to first two invoices
- Onboarding fee: waived for 12-month commit; HSM provisioning fee of $5,000 remains billable to cover dedicated HSM partitions
- Marketplace: if routed via AWS Marketplace, provide an additional 4% marketplace credit (we cannot overlap Marketplace discount with direct-signing discounts)
- BAA: included and starts on contract signature; SOC 2 Type II and pen-test summary attached to our legal portal (we'll share link with your security team).

I uploaded a clean proposal PDF so procurement can attach to the PO packet. If this looks good, we'll convert to DocuSign and route to Legal for the BAA and standard SOW. If procurement needs a 15% committed discount we could stretch to that for a 36-month deal — would need an executive sign-off.

Proposal attached: proposal_atma_v2.pdf

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Leena Rao <procurement@atma-med.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700

Grace — thank you. The breakdown is clear and procurement is comfortable taking this to execs. Two quick items before we proceed to a PO: 1) please send a DocuSign with the proposal and BAA; 2) we need a single-sheet line-item cost table that the CFO can review showing monthly and annual spend under the 12-month discount. I attached a short PO-intent doc that our legal team uses as a placeholder.

If you can get DocuSign to us this week, we can keep the Oct 25 selection timeline.

Regards,
Leena
